dbt-prod-guard.description: Blocks a dbt command on a production target (prod, production, prd or AI_KIT_PROD_TARGETS) unless AI_KIT_ALLOW_PROD=1.

protected-paths.description: Always blocks agent writes to the configuration of the kit and of the CLIs (also through simple shell commands); also blocks writes under the patterns listed in <repo>/.ai-kit/protected-paths. On by default.
